Labels.org.opencontainers.image.description:
The Ubuntu container image maintained by Canonical

Ubuntu is a Debian-based Linux operating system that runs from the desktop to the cloud, to all your internet connected things.
It is the world's most popular operating system across public clouds and OpenStack clouds.
It is the number one platform for containers; from Docker to Kubernetes to LXD, Ubuntu can run your containers at scale.
Fast, secure and simple, Ubuntu powers millions of PCs worldwide.

RUN |1 TARGETPLATFORM=linux/amd64 /bin/sh -c apt-get -y update &&     apt-get -y dist-upgrade &&     apt-get -y install --no-install-recommends         $([ "$TARGETPLATFORM" != "linux/amd64" ] || echo gcc-multilib g++-multilib)         build-essential yasm nasm         xxd pkgconf curl wget unzip zip git subversion mercurial rsync jq         autoconf automake libtool libtool-bin libltdl-dev autopoint gettext cmake ninja-build         clang llvm lcov lld qemu-user         texinfo texi2html help2man flex bison groff libxml2-utils         gperf itstool ragel libc6-dev zlib1g-dev libssl-dev         gtk-doc-tools gobject-introspection gawk         ocaml ocaml-findlib ocamlbuild libnum-ocaml-dev indent p7zip-full zstd libarchive-tools         default-jdk-headless ant         python3-setuptools python3-pip python3-venv python3-jinja2 python3-jsonschema python3-apt python3-dev python-is-python3 &&     curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x | bash - &&     apt-get -y install nodejs &&     apt-get -y autoremove &&     apt-get -y clean autoclean &&     rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* &&     git config --global user.email "builder@localhost" &&     git config --global user.name "Builder" &&     git config --global advice.detachedHead false # buildkit

RUN |1 TARGETPLATFORM=linux/amd64 /bin/sh -c wget https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/a/autoconf/autoconf_2.73-2_all.deb -O autoconf.deb &&     dpkg -i autoconf.deb &&     rm autoconf.deb # buildkit
RUN |1 TARGETPLATFORM=linux/amd64 /bin/sh -c python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages meson # buildkit

RUN |1 TARGETPLATFORM=linux/amd64 /bin/sh -c curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | bash -s -- -y --no-modify-path &&     cargo install cargo-c && rm -rf "${CARGO_HOME}"/registry "${CARGO_HOME}"/git # buildkit
RUN |1 TARGETPLATFORM=linux/amd64 /bin/sh -c for s in /input/*.sh; do cp $s /usr/bin/$(echo $s | sed -e 's|.*/||' -e 's/\.sh$//'); done # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/crosstool-ng/crosstool-ng.git /ct-ng && cd /ct-ng &&     ./bootstrap &&     ./configure --enable-local &&     make -j$(nproc) &&     cp /.config .config &&     ./ct-ng build &&     cd / &&     rm -rf ct-ng # buildkit
RUN /bin/sh -c apt-get -y update &&     apt-get -y install --no-install-recommends wine &&     apt-get -y clean autoclean &&     rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c rustup target add "$FFBUILD_RUST_TARGET" &&     echo "[target.$FFBUILD_RUST_TARGET]
linker = "${FFBUILD_TOOLCHAIN}-gcc"
ar = "${FFBUILD_TOOLCHAIN}-gcc-ar"
" > "$CARGO_HOME"/config.toml # buildkit
